mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 55 degrees with overcast skies at Verona Community Park and an air quality index of 54. The moon is in its third quarter phase, and the ISS will pass overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

The city contracts with Pellitteri Waste Systems for residential refuse and recycling services. Residents can check the Pellitteri website for schedules and use the Waste Wizard tool to determine how to dispose of specific items.
We have a busy schedule ahead. Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening today. Tomorrow, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's.
In a noteworthy call from October 23, Verona police contacted two thirteen-year-old juveniles riding prohibited eMotos, resulting in their parents receiving citations.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The restaurant is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM.
